title: Analysis code for: R-Loop Regulator Activity in Bladder Cancer Mainly Reflects Proliferation: An Integrative Single-Cell, Spatial and Bulk Transcriptomic Study
description: R and Python scripts used to score R-loop regulators in single-cell, spatial and bulk transcriptomic data from bladder cancer, build a 16-gene R-loop-related risk score and benchmark it against proliferation, random gene sets and published bladder cancer signatures.
